items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: Password field with a reveal toggle (button with aria-pressed and a stable accessible name) and a Caps Lock hint from getModifierState, inside a Field.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Default autoComplete is current-password; use new-password when choosing a password. The Caps Lock hint is announced through a persistent status region. `autoHide` (default true) hides a revealed password when focus leaves the group, on submit/reset of the owning form and when the tab is hidden; the type swaps without remount and the selection is restored; the state is announced (표시됨/숨김) through a polite sr-only status. `strength` 0-4 draws four fixed segments and a label (host computes the level; announced after 600 ms of stability). MIGRATION: a revealed password no longer stays revealed after Tab away; pass autoHide={false} to keep v3 behaviour.
